created_files.purpose: Memory-efficient streaming file scanner using os.scandir()
key_components: scan_directory() - yields chunks of file paths
scan_to_list() - convenience method for loading all files

created_files.purpose: Comprehensive test suite for file scanner

patterns_discovered.performance_optimization: Used os.scandir() instead of Path.rglob() for 2.6-3.1x performance improvement based on Phase 1 benchmarks
patterns_discovered.memory_efficiency: Chunked iteration pattern with configurable chunk size prevents memory exhaustion with 50,000+ file directories
patterns_discovered.generator_based_api: Used Python generators for lazy evaluation and memory-efficient processing
patterns_discovered.configuration_pattern: Implemented ScanConfig dataclass similar to patterns in existing deduplication detector
patterns_discovered.error_resilience: Graceful handling of permission errors and inaccessible files with logging instead of exceptions
patterns_discovered.callback_pattern: Progress callback mechanism for real-time scan progress tracking
patterns_discovered.stat_optimization: Uses os.DirEntry.stat() instead of Path.stat() to avoid redundant syscalls

gotchas_discovered.pytest_execution_blocked: Full pytest test execution blocked by network/proxy issues preventing pip install of pytest in venv
gotchas_discovered.symlink_handling_complexity: Symlinks require additional checks for both file and directory status, cannot use fast-path DirEntry API
gotchas_discovered.memory_trade_off: scan_to_list() method loads entire directory into memory - documented but could be misused with large directories
gotchas_discovered.test_verification_incomplete: While syntax validated and logic manually verified, comprehensive pytest suite not executed due to environment constraints
